column1: # testees/pcrec/list_axes.tsv -- the pcrec optimization-axis REGISTRY at the
# pin, archived VERBATIM (pcrec D35: stable name, verbatim output, a source
# header). Everything below this header is the unmodified output of:
# b18repin ([B18]). 47 data rows / 19 axes / 12 columns -- the FOURTH
# WHAT THIS FILE IS FOR: adapter.py's declared stamp value sets are CHECKED
# against it (`registry_check`), and `make check-harness` diffs this copy
# `check_list_axes_registry`), so a candidate pcrec adds -- a new prefilter
# form, a new match form -- surfaces as a failing check naming the value,
# not as the first record's X15 rejection. Re-archive at every re-pin: the
# diff IS the list of what moved. The registry's own boundary (registry.md
# 6): it proves what the compiler THINKS its axes are; the artifacts
# KNOWN GAP AT THIS PIN (a finding for pcrec, [B18]): the `size-term` axis
# names `RX_UNROLL_K_WHY` as its stamp_macro but carries an EMPTY
# stamp_value on both rows, although that macro is name-valued (seven
# values, match_api.md 6.3) -- so `unroll_k_why`'s declared set comes from
# the spec, not from here, and `registry_check` does not cover it.
# TSV surface; [CHK-2] piece 1). One row per (axis, candidate), in
# PREFERENCE order within the axis (order 1 is tried first).
# kind: "list" — a real candidate-list-of-objects exists in
#   src/gen/emit_dfa.c and this row's name/deny came straight off it.
#   "both" — axis F (scan direction): not a preference list, both
#   candidates are ALWAYS emitted, once each, per machine.
#   "predicate" — no candidate-list-as-data exists yet for this axis
#   ([ENG-FORM] relayered emit_dfa.c only); name/deny are hand-stated
#   from lib/pcrec.h's own enum symbols and docs/spec/tuning.md's
#   prose. See this file's (src/parse/axes_dump.c) own header comment
#   for the full boundary this dump does and does not prove.
# stamp_macro/stamp_value: the emitted #define this candidate is
# reported through and the value it takes when chosen — empty when no
# such macro exists (axes C/D/E/F; the activity-count axes, whose
# stamp is a NUMBER rather than a named value).
# PCREC_FORCE_* bit (lib/pcrec.h) that removes/forces this candidate,
# empty when none exists — axis B's own missing deny flag is a named
# cli_flag: the -f/-fno-/--engine= spelling, empty for a candidate
